name: Algorithm override
description: Sets the algorithm inside 9012, replacing the algorithm from 9001 (client algo). The value is upper-cased and passed through the shorthand map (algo_from_shorthand); an unknown/invalid name is silently ignored and the previous algorithm is kept. The whole tag is ignored when the OEO config lists the current algorithm in no_algo_tag. It also derives the impact algorithm (e.g. SHADOW1/2/3 -> SHADOW, VWAP1..3/OPEVWAPn -> VWAP, ICEDMA -> SDMA).

example.explanation: Run the order as PASS regardless of the 9001 algorithm.

interactions.title: 9012 ALGO beats 9001
interactions.explanation: __p_1_ALGO assigns _algorithm directly while parsing 9012, which happens after 9001 has been read (parse900Tags/processAlgorithm), so a valid sub-tag 1 replaces the 9001 algorithm and any relay conversion computed from it. Greek tags 9004-9007 are mapped using the algorithm in effect before 9012 is parsed, and are re-parsed only when the 9012 algo differs from the client algo (parsegreek).

interactions.title: Ignored for algorithms listed in no_algo_tag
interactions.explanation: If Util.getOEOConfig().no_algo_tag(<current algorithm>) is true the tag is not applied at all.

interactions.title: Config converts limit DMA orders to DLP
interactions.explanation: Rules write 1=DLP^104=1^AUNS=1 for SDMA/DMA(/ICEDMA) limit orders starting before the close when USEDLP is 1 (DMA/SDMA) or 2 (incl. ICEDMA).

interactions.title: Client templates keyed on tag 88 rewrite the algorithm
interactions.explanation: Several rules use the value of sub-tag 88 as a template key and write ALGO=LINE (88=MFSIS), ALGO=PASS (88=PORT with 9001=FALL), ALGO=VWAP (88=SgaMoc) or ALGO=SHADOW (88=APSHADOWn) together with other parameters.

interactions.title: Order rejected if final algorithm is invalid
interactions.explanation: After parsing, an invalid final algorithm sets _err_msg 'invalid algorithm'. Note an invalid sub-tag 1 value is itself ignored, so this only fires when 9001 is also invalid.

name: Start time / start offset after open
description: Order start time. A value ending in s/m/h is an offset from the continuous-session open (e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h) stored as start_open; otherwise it is parsed as a clock time (like 9002) and flagged for timezone conversion. Because 9012 is parsed after 9002, this replaces the 9002 start time.

example.explanation: Start 5 minutes after the continuous open.

interactions.title: Sub-tag 2 replaces 9002
interactions.explanation: Both set _startstamp/_tag9002; 9002 is parsed in parse900Tags before 9012, so the 9012 value wins.

interactions.title: Offset start disables do-open
interactions.explanation: When the start is an offset after the open (start_open>0) the opening-auction participation computed from 14/9009 is cleared (customtags_open=0), and ExecutionOptimizer sets the start to open+offset.

interactions.title: Config clears 217/218/219 when start is before MOO
interactions.explanation: Rule writes 217=0^218=0^219=0 when 217 is set, tag 2 is present and start_to_moo>0.

name: End time
description: Order end time as a clock time (same parsing as 9003), flagged for timezone conversion. Parsed after 9003 so it replaces it. Inside a compound leg (9060) it ends that leg at a clock time.

interactions.title: Sub-tag 3 replaces 9003
interactions.explanation: Both set _endstamp/_tag9003; 9003 is parsed first in parse900Tags, so the 9012 value wins.

interactions.title: Close tag with early end time is rejected
interactions.explanation: With 15=1 and an end time before the closing auction end (and reset_close_endstamp==0 for the stock) the order is rejected 'in close tag conflict with endstamp'.

interactions.title: End time decides close participation in EU/US
interactions.explanation: In the EU region an end at/after continuous end turns do-close on, an earlier end turns it off (unless moc_rate_type>=20); with 9009 in other regions the end vs closing-auction begin decides close participation.

name: Aggression
description: Aggressiveness level of the algo in [-1, 1] (negative = more passive, positive = more aggressive). Used throughout candidate sizing and venue logic (e.g. SHADOW with aggression < -0.5 shrinks workable size, NINJA with aggression >= 1 behaves aggressively, qmoc close rate shifts by 20*aggression).

interactions.title: Sub-tag 4 beats 9004 alpha
interactions.explanation: parseGreekTags copies 9004 (alpha) into _aggression for these algos; 9012 is parsed afterwards so sub-tag 4 wins.

interactions.title: Aggression below -1 rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'aggression out of range' when aggression < -1 or > 1.

interactions.title: Aggression above 1 rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'aggression out of range' when aggression > 1.

interactions.title: Aggressive NINJA cannot use cash balance
interactions.explanation: checkForError rejects 'aggressive NINJA with Cash feature' when a NINJA-like algo has aggression>0 and cash balancing is on.

name: Min participation rate
description: Minimum participation rate in percent of market volume. For SHADOW-family algos it is the minimum rate (9007 delta maps here), for LINE/PART 9005 beta maps here. Validated against configured bounds.
default: 0 (none); when this tag is absent: GNR conversion defaults 5=8 / 6=25 (Parameters.java:12591)

algorithmDependent.behavior: Ignored: minPartLevel() returns the target rate (tag 7) and parse9012 overwrites _minpartlevel with the target.

interactions.title: Ignored for PART (target rate used)
interactions.explanation: After 9012 parsing PART sets min=max=target part level, and minPartLevel() returns _targetpartlevel for PART.

interactions.title: Min rate above max rate rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'min part level > max part level' when both >0 and min>max.

interactions.title: Min rate <=1% cannot be combined with dark only
interactions.explanation: checkForError rejects a min part level in (0,1] when Dark Only (37=1) is set.

interactions.title: Rate outside configured bounds rejected
interactions.explanation: Rejected when min part level > min(100, minpart_reject) or below min(1, minpart_reject_min).

interactions.title: BernX-only cannot combine with min part
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'BernX-only cannot combine with iwould or min part' when internal cross is 2.

name: Max participation rate
description: Maximum participation rate (volume cap) in percent of market volume. 9005 beta (VWAP/TMX/PART/FALL/CASH) or 9007 delta (LINE/PCAP/SMKT/IIS/SMALL/PASS/GNR) map here; sub-tag 6 is parsed later and wins.

algorithmDependent.behavior: Ignored: maxPartLevel() returns the target rate (tag 7).
Ignored: maxPartLevel() returns tag 16 (max work part rate).

interactions.title: Ignored for PART
interactions.explanation: maxPartLevel() returns _targetpartlevel for PART and parse9012 overwrites _maxpartlevel with the target.

interactions.title: Ignored for WOW (tag 16 used)
interactions.explanation: maxPartLevel() returns _maxworkpartrate for WOW.

interactions.title: Max rate outside configured bounds rejected
interactions.explanation: Rejected when > min(100, maxpart_reject) or >0 and < min(1, maxpart_reject_min).

interactions.title: Max rate disables default must-complete
interactions.explanation: mustComplete() defaults to the algorithm's default only when maxPartLevel()<=0; setting 6 makes the order not must-complete unless 23=1.

interactions.title: China: volume cap with must-complete is KO'd
interactions.explanation: Config rule writes KO 'Volume cap ... conflicting with Must Complete 23=1' for China.

interactions.title: Config defaults 6=50 for adaptive LINE
interactions.explanation: LINE with index-tracker adaption 1/2/5/6 and no max rate gets 6=50.

name: Target participation rate
description: Target participation rate in percent. For PART it is the participation rate (min and max are both set to it); for PART2 it sets the lit target rate instead. For other algos it sets targetPartLevel (also used as the default MOC part level).

algorithmDependent.behavior: Sets the participation rate; min=max=target after parsing; 9005 beta also maps here.
Sets the lit target rate (_targetlitpartlevel); min/max lit = target; halved for small caps / large %ADV (see 58/61).

interactions.title: PART without a positive rate rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'part rate <= 0' when PART and minPartLevel()<=0 (which is the target).

interactions.title: PART target replaces min/max
interactions.explanation: parse9012 sets _maxpartlevel=_minpartlevel=_targetpartlevel for PART (and lit levels for PART2).

interactions.title: Meaning depends on algorithm at parse time
interactions.explanation: __p_7 checks _algorithm == PART2 while parsing; the lit vs non-lit field chosen depends on the algorithm in effect when tag 7 is read.

interactions.title: India IIS->VWAP clears target
interactions.explanation: Config rule writes 7=0 for IN orders whose 9001 is IIS but run as VWAP with a target rate.

name: Participation range
description: Allowed band around the target participation rate (percent). For PART sets partRange; for PART2 sets the lit part range. 9004 alpha maps here for PART/PART2.

algorithmDependent.behavior: Sets _litpartrange; halved together with lit rates for small caps / large %ADV.

name: Max lit participation rate
description: Maximum participation rate on lit venues (percent). For NINJA/ICENINJA 9006 gamma maps here; for PART2 9005 beta maps here (and tag 7 overwrites it). Used to cap lit shares per period.

example.explanation: At most 10% of volume on lit venues.

interactions.title: Lit max above max rate rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'max lit part level > max part level'.

interactions.title: Out of bounds rejected
interactions.explanation: Rejected when > min(100,maxpart_reject) or >0 and too small.

interactions.title: PART2: replaced by lit target
interactions.explanation: parse9012 sets _maxlitpartlevel=_targetlitpartlevel for PART2.

name: Would price (I-would)
description: Opportunistic 'would' price: when the market reaches it the algo trades more aggressively. Accepts an absolute price, or a relative spec parsed by IWouldPrice (e.g. B<bps> / C<cps> offsets as in 'B-10,3'). A value starting with 'M' and containing at least 3 ':'-separated fields is a multiple-would spec for the scheduler (mult_iwouldpmode=1). Ignored for WOW algos (non-M values).
default: none (WOW: wow_default_wouldstr; SMKT: B-6); when this tag is absent: APIH: would % without 10/31 KO'd (ai.fixmsg.properties:475)

example.explanation: Would trigger 10 bps better than the reference (rule used in SSGA template).

algorithmDependent.behavior: Plain values ignored; WOW uses 9007/tag 17 bps or config default.
Defaults to B-6 if no would price given.

interactions.title: Unparseable would price rejected
interactions.explanation: parametersFinalProcess sets 'incorrect iwould price tag' when IWouldPrice parsing is invalid.

interactions.title: Cash balance cannot combine with would
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'cash-balance cannot combine with iwould'.

interactions.title: BernX-only cannot combine with would
interactions.explanation: checkForError rejects internal cross 2 with a would price.

interactions.title: Explicit would price beats range tags 17/31
interactions.explanation: The range (17/31) is only used to build the would string when 10 is not set.

interactions.title: With 207, would venue becomes dark+lit
interactions.explanation: If would-dark price 207 is given and 11 is not, tag 10 present makes the would venue 3 (dark and lit), otherwise 1 (dark only).

interactions.title: Ignored for WOW
interactions.explanation: __p_10 only stores non-M values when !_algorithm.isWOW().

name: Would venue (would dark)
description: Where would executions may go: 0/lit = lit only (default), 1/dark = dark, 2 = dark+hidden, 3/darklit/litdark = dark+hidden+visible; 4,5,6 choose between levels by stock size: 4 = 1 or 2, 5 = 2 or 3, 6 = 1 or 3, using ',<T|A|C>,<value>' (T: ADV traded value >= value*1e6; A: order/ADV <= value%; C: market cap USD >= value*1000) to decide 'large cap'. Ignored for WOW.
default: 0 (PART2 forces 1); when this tag is absent: PART2 defaults to dark (Parameters.java:12576)

example.explanation: Dark+hidden; also visible if order is <= 1% of ADV.

interactions.title: Invalid text value rejected
interactions.explanation: parseWDCompatible sets _err_msg 'invalid would dark tag 11' for unknown words.

interactions.title: Disabled under Reg SHO enforcement 3
interactions.explanation: wouldVenue() returns 0 when the stock enforces Reg SHO mode 3 and the order is Reg SHO.

interactions.title: Ignored for WOW
interactions.explanation: __p_11_WD only applies when !_algorithm.isWOW().

interactions.title: Config KO: 383 with would dark
interactions.explanation: Rule writes KO '383 With WouldDark'.

name: Cash balance
description: Turns cash (dollar) balancing across the buy and sell legs of a basket on (>0) or off. Forced to 1 for CASH, FALL and PAIR algos and for any pair order (tag 44), and by tags 20/22.

example.explanation: Balance buy and sell notional across the portfolio.

interactions.title: Cash balance with would rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'cash-balance cannot combine with iwould'.

interactions.title: Cash balance with BernX-only rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'cash-balance cannot combine with BernX only'.

interactions.title: Forced on for CASH/FALL/PAIR
interactions.explanation: parametersFinalProcess sets _do_cash=1 when algorithm.needDoCash() or isPair(); 13=0 is overridden.

interactions.title: Disables relay algos, split and 100-share block
interactions.explanation: computeRelayAlgorithm/adjustRelayAlgorithm return early when doCash()>0 (no relay/split); block_first_100_shares() returns 0.

interactions.title: PORT template sets PASS + cash
interactions.explanation: Rule writes ALGO=PASS^13=1^37=0 for 9001=FALL with 88=PORT.

name: Do open auction
description: Participate in the opening auction. >0 sets doOpen to that value (1 normal; 2 is also accepted as doOpen and used e.g. for market orders); 0 explicitly excludes the open; default -1 = unspecified (inferred from 9009 and timing). Only sets doOpen when >0, so 14=0 does not clear a doOpen from 9009 but does block inference.
default: -1 (unspecified); when this tag is absent: Config sets 14=0 when 9002 is after earliest open auction (ai.fixmsg.properties:309, ai.fixmsg.properties:24, ai.fixmsg.properties:25)

example.explanation: Send to the opening auction if the order arrives before the open.

interactions.title: Unspecified 14 defers to 9009
interactions.explanation: In EU/AP, inOpen9014==-1 with 9009 present uses doOpen from 9009 (9009=1/3).

interactions.title: Open-referenced limit better than open clears do-open
interactions.explanation: If tag 92 references the open (O) with negative percent/ticks, _inopen9014 is set to 0.

interactions.title: BernX-only cannot do open
interactions.explanation: checkForErrorFinal: 'BernX-only cannot combine with do open'.

interactions.title: Do-open with start after open rejected (config)
interactions.explanation: With reject_start_after_open 1/3, a do-open order whose start time is after continuous begin is rejected.

interactions.title: Config KO: 217/218 with 14=0
interactions.explanation: Rule KO 'Tag 217 and 218 coexist with tag 14=0'.

interactions.title: Offset start (tag 2 s/m/h) cancels do-open
interactions.explanation: customtags_open is reset to 0 when start_open>0.

name: Do close auction
description: Participate in the closing auction. >0 sets doClose to that value; 0 explicitly excludes the close; default -1 = unspecified (inferred: e.g. US scheduled market orders ending at the close, IIS). Send exactly 1: the auction gate tests doClose()==1, so 15=2 passes entry checks but silently fails at the auction. Close size also needs moc_mode (232) and a reserve (26/27).
default: -1 (unspecified); when this tag is absent: HK short sell sets 15 by algo (ai.fixmsg.properties:135, ai.fixmsg.properties:136)

example.explanation: Reserve shares for and send to the closing auction.

interactions.title: 15=2+ never reaches the close
interactions.explanation: ExecutionCustomizer requires doClose()==1 for close candidates ('source_not_doclose').

interactions.title: 15=1 with early end time rejected
interactions.explanation: 'in close tag conflict with endstamp'.

interactions.title: JP/IN: 15=0 after continuous end KO'd
interactions.explanation: Config KO '9012tag 15 0 after continuous end'.

interactions.title: APAC default 15=1 when unspecified
interactions.explanation: Rule writes 15=1 when neither 9009 nor 15 was given in most Asian markets (fields flagged as possibly unsupported, C-19).

interactions.title: SHADOW without would/min rate: 15=0
interactions.explanation: Rule writes 15=0.

interactions.title: After continuous end converts to MOC
interactions.explanation: Orders arriving after continuous end with inClose9015==1 (or unspecified without 9009) are converted via setEUMOCAfterClose (unless SHADOW-with-min-rate, MOC, test, or excluded).

interactions.title: Unspecified 15 defers to 9009
interactions.explanation: inClose9015==-1 with 9009 uses doClose from 9009 (2/3).

name: Max work participation rate (WOW)
description: Maximum participation rate for the WOW algorithm (percent); maxPartLevel() returns it for WOW. 9005 beta maps here for WOW.

example.explanation: WOW: cap working at 15% of volume.

interactions.title: Only used by WOW
interactions.explanation: maxPartLevel() returns _maxworkpartrate only for WOW; other algos ignore it.

name: Would range (WOW)
description: Would-price offset for WOW algos: builds the would string B<value> (bps, default) or C<value> if tag 18 starts with C, and sets the WOW bps when in bps. Ignored for non-WOW algos (use tag 31 there).

interactions.title: Ignored for non-WOW
interactions.explanation: __p_17 only stores the value when isWOW(); tag 31 is the non-WOW equivalent.

name: Would range unit
description: Unit for the would range in tags 17/31: a value starting with C means cents (C<range>), anything else bps (B<range>).

interactions.title: Needs 17 or 31
interactions.explanation: Only read when building the would string from _iwould_range.

name: Would percentage
description: Caps how much of the order may execute via would logic. Number = percent of order (values >100 treated as shares); suffix S = shares (converted to percent, sizes rounded up to lot); prefix C = cumulative mode (counts all executions), R = mode 2 (value capped at 100, percentage caps in OrderRegulation not applied).

example.explanation: Would executions limited so total fills <= 33% of order (rule in TROWE template).

interactions.title: Needs a would price
interactions.explanation: The percentage limits would executions; config KO's would % without 10/31 under APIH.

name: Buy/sell cash ratio
description: Target buy/sell notional ratio for cash balancing; setting it forces cash balancing on (do_cash=1). For CASH, 9006 gamma maps here. Also switches sector balance doSector() to 1 when tag 91>0.

example.explanation: Keep buy and sell notional equal.

interactions.title: Forces cash balance on
interactions.explanation: __p_20_BSR sets _do_cash=1, which also triggers the cash-balance rejects with would/BernX.

name: Cash tolerance
description: Allowed deviation (range) around the cash-balance ratio. For CASH 9007 delta maps here.

interactions.title: Tolerance and dollar leads cannot coexist
interactions.explanation: checkForError: 'cash-balance ratio tolerance and dollar bounds cannot coexist'.

name: Cash balance with residual
description: Turns cash balancing on and, if the value is 1 or starts with R, enables residual cash balancing (do_cashresidual), which enables rimb_aggr.

interactions.title: Forces cash balance on
interactions.explanation: Always sets _do_cash=1.

name: Must complete
description: Force (1) or disable (0) must-complete. Other values of the form '<T|A|C>,<value>' make it conditional: must-complete only if the stock is 'large' (T: ADV traded value >= value*1e6; A: order <= value% of ADV; C: market cap USD >= value*1000). If unset, mustComplete() uses the algorithm default only when no max rate, no cash balance and no CIS switch.
default: algorithm default (-1); when this tag is absent: Config defaults 23=1 for VWAP/TMX (ai.fixmsg.properties:45, ai.fixmsg.properties:607, ai.fixmsg.properties:280)

example.explanation: Must complete only if order is <= 5% of ADV.

interactions.title: China: must complete with volume cap KO'd
interactions.explanation: Config KO.

interactions.title: Passive setting conflicts with must complete
interactions.explanation: Config KO when 173 passive-only (not 4/9) is combined with 23=1.

interactions.title: IIS close inference uses 23
interactions.explanation: IIS with 15 not 0 auto-closes when mustCompleteTag()==0 or start before preCloseEnd.

name: Minimum execution (min fill) size
description: Minimum fill quantity for venues that support it. Plain number = shares. Prefixed forms: RLS<n> = n round lots, ATS<n> = n x average trade size, AQS<n> = n x average quote size, PCT<n> = n% of the work order, <CCY><n> (e.g. USD20000) = minimum notional in that currency (converted to stock currency).
default: 0 (none); when this tag is absent: Config defaults/KO for CITADV (ai.fixmsg.properties:183, ai.fixmsg.properties:184)

example.explanation: Only accept fills of at least USD 20,000 notional.

interactions.title: Missing lot/trade/quote data rejects
interactions.explanation: _err_msg 'null stock or 0 round lot size/avg trade size/avg quote size'.

interactions.title: Invalid currency rejected
interactions.explanation: 'currency invalid in tag 24'.

interactions.title: Min fill too large vs order rejected
interactions.explanation: 'MinFill Qty Greater Than x of Order Size' when above minfill_reject_threshold.

interactions.title: Venue selection depends on tag 53
interactions.explanation: With 53>0 venues that do not allow the min size are skipped; 53=2 restricts to venues with minExec==2.

name: DMA posting mode
description: Which venues a DMA/DLP strategy posts on: 0 = none (take only), 1 = broker primary exchange only, 2 = SMARTPOST venues (fallback to POST), 3 = POST venues (default).

interactions.title: Config rewrites 25=1 to 3
interactions.explanation: Rule '9012=25=3 :: tag9012(25)=1' turns broker-primary posting into normal posting; another rule defaults 25=3 for DMA family.

name: MOC rate (close reserve)
description: Amount to reserve for the closing auction, interpreted per tag 27 (moc_rate_type): percent of estimated close volume, of order, of ADV, etc. Optional 2nd/3rd fields are %ADV and %order-size caps, only used when 27 is 30-37.

example.explanation: With 27=1: reserve 20% of the order for the close.

interactions.title: Rate >100 rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError 'in valid moc_rate' unless moc_rate_type is 8/18/38.

interactions.title: Needs 27 to take effect
interactions.explanation: Smart close relay and close ownership require moc_rate_type>-1 and moc_rate>0; without 27 the type is -1.

interactions.title: IIS 100% close converts to MOC
interactions.explanation: IIS with moc_rate_type 1 and rate 100 (and allow_would<=0, lot-compatible) is converted with setIISToMOC; Indian close algos are reset to VWAP.

name: MOC rate type
description: How tag 26 is interpreted and who owns the close: 0 = % of estimated close, 1 = % of order, 2 = % of ADV, 3 = % of average close, 4 = no MOC, 5 = same as 0, 6 = % of max(historical estimate, indicated size); 10-13 = same as 0-3 but MOC issued after close; 30-37 use tag 26 fields 2/3 as %ADV/%size caps. Second field = moc_reserve_allow_would (allow would on reserved shares). Any value >=0 makes the OPE own the close (doCloseOpe).

example.explanation: Tag 26 is a percent of the order.

interactions.title: Moves close ownership to OPE
interactions.explanation: doCloseOpe() returns 1 when moc_rate_type>=0, so doCloseScheduler() becomes 0.

interactions.title: Types 10-19 convert late orders to MOC
interactions.explanation: After continuous end, moc_rate_type 10-19 triggers setEUMOCAfterClose.

interactions.title: Types >=20 keep close in EU when end is early
interactions.explanation: EU: early end time clears close only if moc_rate_type<20.

interactions.title: Enables SMART_CLOSE relay
interactions.explanation: With smart_close_compound enabled, moc_rate_type>-1 and moc_rate>0 sets the SMART_CLOSE relay algorithm.

name: MOC all-in auction mode
description: When the whole order goes to the close (all in auction): 0 = send MOC with the normal delays, 1 = send the MOC as soon as possible (at the computed preclose start).

name: Would range (non-WOW)
description: Would-price offset for non-WOW algos when no explicit would price (tag 10): builds B<value> (bps) or C<value> (cents if tag 18 starts with C). Ignored for WOW algos (tag 17 there).

example.explanation: Would at 10 bps better than reference.

interactions.title: Ignored when 10 is set
interactions.explanation: Range is only used when _iwouldpricestr is null.

interactions.title: Ignored for WOW
interactions.explanation: __p_31 only applies when !isWOW().

name: Would-stop price
description: Absolute 'would stop' price (a would trigger on the adverse side). Used when tag 33 (range) is 0/unset. Ignored for WOW.

interactions.title: Range 33 wins
interactions.explanation: If |33|>0 the range is used instead.

name: Would-stop range
description: Would-stop offset, in bps (default) or cents if tag 35 starts with C; takes precedence over tag 32. Invalid spec rejects ('incorrect iwould stop price tag'). Ignored for WOW.

name: Would-stop dark
description: Whether would-stop executions go to dark venues (1 or a value containing 'dark'). Ignored for WOW.

name: Would-stop range unit
description: Unit of tag 33: starts with C = cents, otherwise bps. Ignored for WOW.

name: BernX (internal cross) only
description: Any value >0 sets internal cross mode 2 = cross only internally (BernX only).

interactions.title: Cannot combine with cash balance
interactions.explanation: 'cash-balance cannot combine with BernX only'.

interactions.title: Cannot combine with would or min rate
interactions.explanation: 'BernX-only cannot combine with iwould or min part'.

interactions.title: Cannot combine with do open
interactions.explanation: checkForErrorFinal.

interactions.title: No relay/split
interactions.explanation: computeRelayAlgorithm/adjustRelayAlgorithm return early with internal cross 2; only CROSS candidates are processed.

interactions.title: Shares field with 51
interactions.explanation: Both write _internal_cross; the later-parsed one wins (36 only ever writes 2).

name: Dark only
description: 1 = execute only on dark venues (blind exchanges skipped otherwise allowed; lit venues excluded except would-type candidates).

interactions.title: Min rate <=1% with dark only rejected
interactions.explanation: checkForError.

name: DMA all-in auction mode
description: For DMA algos, send the whole order into the auction: 1 = open, 2 = close, 3 = both, 4 = both but only for limit orders.
default: -1 (off); config: 1 JP, 3 elsewhere for DMA family; when this tag is absent: Config default 1 (JP) / 3 (others) (ai.fixmsg.properties:468, ai.fixmsg.properties:469)

example.explanation: All-in to open and close auctions.

interactions.title: All-in open after pre-open rejected
interactions.explanation: AUCTION_REJECTED when dma_all_in_open, doOpen>0 and arriving after preOpenPeriodEnd.

interactions.title: All-in close after continuous end -> MOC
interactions.explanation: setEUMOCAfterClose for DMA with dma_all_in_close.

name: Wait-to-begin price
description: Price condition that must be met before the order starts working (IWouldPrice syntax: absolute price or relative bps/cps). When set and valid the WAIT_TO_BEGIN relay algorithm is used.

example.explanation: Start only after price is 20 bps better.

interactions.title: Uses WAIT_TO_BEGIN relay
interactions.explanation: A non-none ibegin price sets RelayAlgorithm.WAIT_TO_BEGIN (unless compound/scale/index/OOM relays take precedence).

interactions.title: Invalid price rejected
interactions.explanation: 'incorrect ibegin price tag'.

name: Wait-to-begin range
description: Offset for the wait-to-begin price when tag 39 is not set: B<range> (bps) or C<range> if tag 41 starts with C. Stop-loss style relative specs are sign-flipped only when not given via range.

name: Wait-to-begin range unit
description: Unit for tag 40: C = cents, else bps.

name: Wait-to-begin direction
description: 1 or a value starting with S sets the wait-to-begin price class direction to 1 (otherwise default direction).

interactions.title: DMA default limit/strike rules skipped when 42=1/S
interactions.explanation: Config rules that write 92=S,.. ^54=C/L for DMA orders without a parent relay require tag 42 not 1/S.

name: Pair price mode
description: Prices used to evaluate a pair: 0 = buy at ask/sell at bid, 1 = mid/mid, 2 = last/last, 3 = buy at bid/sell at ask. Must match across both legs.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: checkPairParams: 'pair tag 43 conflict'.

name: Pair spread mode
description: Defines the pair spread and makes the order a pair order (isPair() is true whenever >=0): 0 = price_buy/price_sell ratio (62), 1 = price_buy-price_sell (62), 2 = bps vs reference (62 bps, 63 ref), 3 = buy*ratio+cash-sell, 4 = (buy*ratio+cash)/sell, 5 = mode 4 in bps.
default: -1 (not a pair); when this tag is absent: PAIR without spread mode rejected (Parameters.java:12850)

example.explanation: Trade when buy-sell spread reaches tag 62.

interactions.title: Mode 2 needs tag 63
interactions.explanation: 'pair spread bps mode need reference type'.

interactions.title: Turns on cash balance
interactions.explanation: isPair() forces _do_cash=1; cash ratio = 0 for 47=0 or tag 64 for 47=1.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: 'pair tag 44 conflict'.

name: Pair execution mode
description: 0 = instantaneous spread check, 1 = consider accumulated saving/buffer/room. Must match on both legs.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: 'pair tag 45 conflict'.

name: Pair direction mode
description: 0 = act when better than the spread, 1 = act when worse. Affects spread sign/ratio inversion, deal-input swapping, and compound portfolio tracker. Must match on both legs.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: 'pair tag 46 conflict'.

name: Pair balance mode
description: 0 = keep the initial buy/sell dollar ratio (cash ratio 0), 1 = use the ratio given in tag 64.

interactions.title: Mode 1 needs tag 64
interactions.explanation: Cash ratio is taken from _pair_balance_ratio (tag 64).

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: 'pair tag 47 conflict'.

name: Portfolio group wait time
description: Seconds to wait to group portfolio orders before starting (converted to ms; 0 means default 5 s). Also scales the non-portfolio delay.

example.explanation: Wait 10 s for the rest of the basket.

name: Internal cross (BernX) mode
description: Sets internal crossing mode directly: 0 = no internal cross, 1 = allowed (default), 2 = internal cross only (same as tag 36). internalCross() returns 0 for algos that skip price checks.

interactions.title: Mode 2 has the BernX-only rejects
interactions.explanation: Same rejects as tag 36 (cash balance, would, min part, do open).

name: Dark with grey venues
description: >0 allows grey venues to be used; otherwise grey venues are excluded from dark routing.

name: Min exec enforcement mode
description: How the min fill (tag 24) is enforced on venues: >0 skips venues that do not allow the min size; >=0 applies the parameter min exec on venues with min-exec support; 2 also restricts enforce-min-exec venues to those with minExec==2.

interactions.title: Needs a min fill
interactions.explanation: Only meaningful together with tag 24.

name: Strike (arrival) price mode
description: Which price is used as the strike/arrival reference, first letter upper-cased (e.g. L = last, M = mid, C = cross; mapping per impact strike_mode 0/1/2). Default C for WOW (and when grab mode is on), else L or the impact config.

interactions.title: DMA config sets 54
interactions.explanation: Rules write 54=C before close / 54=L otherwise together with 92.

name: Index tracker (relative pricing)
description: Relative-performance tracker spec 'symbol,reftype,limit' (IndexTracker). Replaced when tags 80+82 (and 81) are given. Invalid spec rejects ('incorrect index tracker') unless close-only tracking.

example.explanation: Track vs HSI with a 50 limit.

interactions.title: 80/81/82 rebuild tag 55
interactions.explanation: If 80 and 82 are set, _index_tracker_str is rebuilt as 80,81(default CS),-|82|.

interactions.title: Invalid tracker rejected
interactions.explanation: 'incorrect index tracker' / 'invalid index tracking parameter'.

interactions.title: Config sets LCR=0.05
interactions.explanation: Rule adds LCR=0.05 for ELKCAP index-tracked orders.

name: Include venue dark take
description: 1 = also try taking on dark venues (dark pings) for supported algos / new SHADOW / NDMA.

name: IOI mode
description: IOI usage: mode[,workPct[,wouldIOI[,m2hCycleSec[,m2hSwapMin]]]]. Modes: 1 type-0 IOI, 2 IOI exclusively, 3/4 would-dark IOI, 5/6 M2H IOI (6 exclusive), 7/8 M2H layer (8 exclusive), 107/108 M2H swap; 11-99 = mode-10 with field 2 as shares instead of percent.

example.explanation: Type-0 IOI, 100% workable, would IOI on (APSHADOW template).

interactions.title: Config sets LIQH=1
interactions.explanation: Rule writes LIQH=1 when 57 is set.

interactions.title: Disables split MET
interactions.explanation: setSplitMET requires ioi_mode<=0.

name: PART2 market-cap threshold / CUSTOM convert
description: PART2: market-cap threshold in $bn (default 3.5) below which lit rates are halved (when tag 61 is not used). 'C...'/'CUSTOM' makes the algo be converted by a CUSTOM step table in 9060 keyed on market cap.

example.explanation: Halve lit rates for caps below $5bn.

interactions.title: CUSTOM algo conversion
interactions.explanation: With a C value 9060 is used as a custom convert table; the order is re-parsed with the selected algo string, or rejected if it starts with REJECT.

name: Return if out of market (OOM)
description: Reaction when price moves beyond the tag 70 benchmark: 1 (or T/Y) = reject/return the order, 2 = switch to the 9060 sub-algo (SWITCH_ALGO_OOM relay), 3 = halt while out of range and resume. Values >10 use value%10 in warn-only mode (no reject).
default: 0; when this tag is absent: Config sets 59=1 when 70 present (ai.fixmsg.properties:308)

example.explanation: Cancel back if price moves too far.

interactions.title: Mode 2 needs a 9060 sub-algo
interactions.explanation: 'incorrect return if oom param'.

interactions.title: Uses SWITCH_ALGO_OOM relay
interactions.explanation: Uses SWITCH_ALGO_OOM relay.

name: PART2 %ADV threshold / CUSTOM convert
description: PART2: if order size exceeds this %ADV the lit rates are halved. GNR (converted): if order %ADV is below it the algo reverts to GNR. 'C...'/'CUSTOM'/'C-TSW' trigger custom conversion (C-TSW uses a fixed TSW table by cap and %ADV).

example.explanation: Halve lit rates if order > 2% ADV.

interactions.title: CUSTOM / TSW conversion
interactions.explanation: Order re-parsed with algo chosen by %ADV; TSW returns e.g. 1=PASS / 1=LINE^5=5^6=25 / SHADOWMIN or 'reject: TSW CUSTOM not in range'.

interactions.title: GNR revert by %ADV
interactions.explanation: GNR revert by %ADV.

name: Pair spread value
description: Spread threshold for the pair (meaning per tag 44), optionally with currency unit '<value><CCY>[/<CCY>]'. Invalid currency rejects. In compound mode 5 defaults to the tracker's first threshold.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: 'pair tag 62 conflict'.

interactions.title: Invalid currency
interactions.explanation: 'pair param unit currency invalid'.

name: Pair spread bps reference
description: Reference price for spread mode 2: CLO (prev close) / 1, OPN (open) / 2, STR (strike) / 3, or '4,<price>' client strike.

name: Pair balance ratio
description: Buy/sell balance ratio used when tag 47=1 (copied to cash ratio), with optional currency unit.

name: Pair lead side
description: Which side leads in a pair (>0 enables leading); with pair_lead_mode>0 makes doCashOPE()=1.

name: Pair lead size
description: How much the leading leg may get ahead: shares (tag 69=0) or percent of executed (tag 69=1).

name: Pair lead size type
description: Unit of tag 68: 0 = shares over balance size, 1 = percent of current executions.

name: Return-if-OOM benchmark
description: Benchmark for tag 59: a price, a reference type (e.g. C close, S strike), or 'ref[,userPrice][,B|C],neg[,pos]' giving bps/cents range; mode 5 form 'ref,p1,p2' gives two prices. Parse errors reject.

interactions.title: Needed by 92=R
interactions.explanation: 'no tag 70 with 92=R' / 'no tag 70 price room with 92=R'.

interactions.title: Config turns on 59=1
interactions.explanation: Config turns on 59=1.

interactions.title: Malformed benchmark rejected
interactions.explanation: 'error parsing return if oom'.

name: Cash buy lead
description: Maximum amount buys may lead sells in cash balancing (dollar; 'P' suffix = percent of value, with min_cash_lead floor).

interactions.title: Cannot coexist with tolerance
interactions.explanation: 'cash-balance ratio tolerance and dollar bounds cannot coexist'.

name: Cash sell lead
description: Maximum amount sells may lead buys in cash balancing ('P' suffix = percent).

interactions.title: Cannot coexist with tolerance
interactions.explanation: Cannot coexist with tolerance.

name: Iceberg display size
description: Iceberg/display size: size[,mode[,randomize]]. Size = shares, AVG<n> = n x average trade size, AQS<f> = f x average quote size. Mode default from OEO config per exchange; randomize factor.

interactions.title: Config KO: iceberg less than round lot
interactions.explanation: Config KO: iceberg less than round lot.

interactions.title: Config KO: DMA market order with display
interactions.explanation: Config KO: DMA market order with display.

interactions.title: AVG with no avg trade size rejected
interactions.explanation: 'iceberg using AVG tradesize with invalid data'.

name: Compound reference price
description: Reference type/price for the compound algo tracker (overrides the reference in the 9060 header; 'ref,price' for user input).

name: SHADOWMIN post loud
description: >0 allows SHADOWMIN (and SHADOW with a min rate) to post visibly; otherwise those algos avoid lit posting.

name: Block first 100 shares
description: Controls the first-100-shares block; >0 enables it. Ignored (0) when cash balancing. Default from AlgoConfig block_first_100_shares.
default: config block_first_100_shares; when this tag is absent: Config defaults 76=0 (ai.fixmsg.properties:274, ai.fixmsg.properties:438, ai.fixmsg.properties:295)

name: VWAP catch-up mode / profile params
description: First field = VWAP catch-up mode (default config for scheduled algos); further fields KEY=VALUE override profile parameters (HM, AM, PA, PB, PD, PR, MSP, MCP, ...).

name: Portfolio price tracker limit
description: Limit string for the portfolio price-move tracker (PortfolioPMTracker); tracker needs 84 and one of 78/96/85.

name: Index tracker adaption
description: Adaptation mode for relative trading: 1/trend, 2/reverse, 3/OTD, 4/PAR, 5, 6, 7. For LINE it changes the impact child algo (3/4 convert to VWAP with VWAPRELATIVE; 5/6 LINERELATIVE[_HIST]; 7 LINERELATIVE_OTD); TMX -> TMXRELATIVE, VWAP -> VWAPRELATIVE.
default: none; when this tag is absent: ARROWST requires 79/80/82 (ai.fixmsg.properties:40, AI-FIXMSG-CONFLICTS.md:47)

interactions.title: LINE converted to VWAP
interactions.explanation: LINE converted to VWAP.

name: Index tracker symbol
description: Symbol to track; with tag 82 builds the index tracker (55 format).

name: Index tracker reference type
description: Reference type for the tracker built from 80/82.

name: Index tracker limit
description: Relative limit for the tracker built from 80; stored as negative absolute value.

name: Portfolio price tracker mode
description: Mode string for PortfolioPMTracker.

name: Portfolio price tracker reference type
description: Reference type for PortfolioPMTracker; required for the tracker to be created.

interactions.title: Invalid tracker rejected
interactions.explanation: 'price-tracked portfolio invalid input'.

name: Portfolio would limit
description: Would limit string for PortfolioPMTracker.

name: Target order id (resubmit)
description: Id of the original (cancelled) order this order resubmits; scale tracker rules relax and history is looked up.

name: Dark venue chase control mode
description: Controls chasing on dark venues; mode 3 enforces a minimum candidate duration for NINJA-like algos and alters regulation.

name: Impact child algorithm (CAIID)
description: Overrides the impact child algorithm (upper-cased algorithm name). In the config file the value is also used as a client template key (PORT, SgaMoc, APSHADOWn, MFSIS, CLOSEB...).

interactions.title: Template key in config
interactions.explanation: Rules match tag9012(88)=... to apply client templates.

name: Ninja limit percent
description: Stored and reported only (order info / toString); no other use found.

name: Strike time
description: Clock time at which the strike price is set (min 5 chars), timezone converted.

name: Sector balance
description: 0 = none, 1 = cash balance within sector using portfolio ratio, 2 = within sector using sector ratio.

name: Limit price from reference
description: Derives a limit price from a reference: [H]<ref>,<percent>,<ticks>,<mode>. H = hard limit. A leading digit is treated as 'C,<...>'. Refs seen in code/config: C, O (open), R (uses tag 70 benchmark), S. Parse errors clear it silently.

interactions.title: Better than open cancels do-open
interactions.explanation: Better than open cancels do-open.

interactions.title: R needs tag 70
interactions.explanation: R needs tag 70.

name: Ninja limit mode
description: Stored/reported only; no further use found.

name: Allowed impact (bps)
description: Maximum impact vs strike in bps; candidates are limited to respect it.

name: Market view
description: Stored/reported only.

name: Portfolio price tracker start
description: Start string for PortfolioPMTracker.

name: Execution style
description: Pair/execution style integer; used in config conditions (PAIR 97=2 -> BCUS=3^OCASH=1).

interactions.title: Config sets BCUS/OCASH
interactions.explanation: Config sets BCUS/OCASH.

name: Pair deal ratio
description: Pair ratios 'r1[,r2]'; swapped per 46 and deal side. Must match on both legs.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: Must match on both legs.

name: Pair deal cash
description: Cash adjustments 'c1[CCY][,c2[CCY]]' for spread modes 3-5. Must match on both legs.

interactions.title: Must match on both legs
interactions.explanation: Must match on both legs.

name: Scale start price
description: SCALE: start price of the scale ladder.

interactions.title: Uses SCALE relay
interactions.explanation: Scale tracker set -> RelayAlgorithm.SCALE.

name: Scale end price
description: SCALE: end price of the scale ladder.

name: Scale increment
description: SCALE: price increment between steps.

name: Scale exec mode
description: SCALE execution mode passed to the ScaleAlgoTracker (its value meanings are in ScaleAlgoTracker, whose source is not in this tree). Compared on resubmission against order history.

name: Ignore limit price check
description: Values 1 or 5 skip checkVwapVolume (the market-order VWAP volume sanity check for scheduled algos). The config also adds 104=1 when converting DMA limit orders to DLP and exempts 104=1 from the 'Smart DMA order with No Limit and a Display Size' KO.

interactions.title: Avoids display KO
interactions.explanation: Avoids display KO.

name: Compound switch fraction
description: Percent (stored x0.01) that turns on two-state switching in the compound algo tracker: the tracker moves from state 0 to 1 when the price diff reaches threshold[1]*(switchNumber+1), and back per tag 108.

interactions.title: Switching has strict requirements
interactions.explanation: checkForError rejects unless there is a compound algo tracker, the client algo is SWITCHER, fraction <=100%, exactly 2 states and a positive second threshold.

name: Compound switch threshold
description: When >0 replaces the second threshold of the compound algo tracker (the switch level).

name: Composite quote mode
description: >0 makes the order use composite VWAP (cvwap) instead of primary VWAP for price references.

interactions.title: Rejected unless the environment supports it
interactions.explanation: 'composite quote not supported in this env' when custom_composite_mode is 0.

interactions.title: Config rewrites 107=1 to 0
interactions.explanation: Rule '9012=107=0 :: tag9012(107)=1' disables composite mode 1.

name: Compound switch margin
description: Percent (stored x0.01) hysteresis for switching back from state 1 to 0: return when diff < threshold[1]*(switchNumber - margin); also defines a margin limit price.

name: Scale step size
description: SCALE: share size of each ladder step, passed to the ScaleAlgoTracker.

name: Halt volume mode
description: When 0 (default) the quote stream is marked halted for the order during circuit-breaker halts and halt-when-out-of-range (59=3) states; non-zero leaves the quote stream untouched.

name: Anti-gaming venue type mode
description: Which venue types to avoid for anti-gaming: 0 = use config (antigame_algos / antigame_venue_type), 1 = avoid periodic-mid venues, 2 = avoid pmid or dark, 3 = avoid pmid, dark or posting venues, 4 = avoid all.

name: End time reject mode
description: Controls rejecting/expiring the order after its end time: mode[,erb]. Mode <=1 also rejects unsent residual after the close; mode 1 measures to the (rolled) end stamp instead of the raw end; even modes reject EXPIRED after a buffer, odd modes reject SEND_ND_EXPIRED immediately; <= -100 disables the expiry reject. Second field (erb) is stored but not read elsewhere in this tree.
default: -1 (config sets 3 when absent); when this tag is absent: Config default 112=3 (ai.fixmsg.properties:425, ai.fixmsg.properties:266, ai.fixmsg.properties:270, AI-FIXMSG-CONFLICTS.md:68)

name: Regulator halt threshold
description: threshold[,mode]: pause the order when the price has moved more than the threshold (spread-normalised bps vs benchmark) from the strike; mode <1 lets candidates ignore the halt. Default comes from config for regulator_halt_algos.

name: Regulator halt min periods
description: Minimum duration (in OEO monitor periods) for the regulator halt logic; <=0 uses config.

name: Regulator halt max periods
description: Maximum duration (in OEO monitor periods) for the regulator halt logic; <=0 uses config.

name: Adjust by beta
description: >0 weights cash/portfolio balancing by the stock's equity beta (eqyBeta) instead of 1.

name: Historical volume mode
description: For LINE with index-tracker adaption (79) other than 3/4/7: >0 selects LINERELATIVE_HIST instead of LINERELATIVE as the impact child algo.
default: 0; when this tag is absent: Config sets 117=1 for ARROWST (ai.fixmsg.properties:38)

name: Index change volume mode
description: >0 uses the index-change closing volume estimate (closingVolume(true)) for close sizing and caps.

name: Index change volume
description: Index-change volume factor; in this tree it is only read by its accessor and printed in the parameter dump. Effect unknown.
